title: Gerente de Projetos Sênior com inglês fluente
description:
Códigos das vagas: 55221 e 55222

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

  • Certificação em gerenciamento de projetos PMP e experiência na indústria financeira, além de ter atuado em entregas de projetos globais de grande escala;
  • Inglês fluente para conversação, escrita e leitura, pois fará uso constante do idioma, participando de reuniões e apresentações em inglês;

Atividades:

  • Apoiar a integração de soluções tecnológicas que ampliem a oferta de produtos do cliente;
  • Desenvolver planos e garantir o progresso na reestruturação de aplicações para os padrões tecnológicos do cliente;
  • Gerenciar aspectos de iniciativas complexas e de grande escala, incluindo planejamento, execução, cronograma, qualidade, satisfação do cliente e identificação precoce de possíveis problemas;
  • Coordenar as tarefas da iniciativa entre diferentes divisões, fluxos, equipes de diferentes áreas e fornecedores.
  • CLT pela BRQ, salário a combinar+ benefícios
  • Híbrida na Faria Lima- São Paulo (3x presencial na semana).

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: AGENTE OPERAÇÕES LEVES (AFIRMATIVA PARA PESSOA COM DEFICIÊNCIA) - UBERLANDIA/MG
description:

Conta também com mais de 200 lojas entre aluguel de carros e venda de seminovos, incluindo leves e pesados, no varejo e atacado.

A companhia, que tem mais de 4 mil colaboradores, é reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil pelo ranking Great Place to Work.

Além disso, foi eleita como a 32ª marca mais valiosa pelo Brand Finance Brazil e, por sete vezes, conquistou o Prêmio Consumidor Moderno de Excelência em Serviço ao Cliente na categoria “Locadora de veículos”. Na Unidas, acreditamos que carreira é jornada , não destino . Somos um dos maiores grupos do Brasil no setor de mobilidade e terceirização de frotas , com soluções completas que vão de veículos leves a pesados, passando por máquinas e equipamentos. Mas o que realmente nos move são as pessoas .

Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo , o aprendizado diário e o empoderamento individual . Acreditamos que cada talento tem o poder de transformar realidades — e oferecemos as ferramentas, o ambiente e os desafios certos para isso acontecer.

Com Mais De 50 Anos De História, Presença Em Todo o Brasil e Mais De 120 Mil Ativos Em Operação, a Unidas é Feita De Movimento, Crescimento e Transformação. Atuamos Com Excelência Em Diversas Frentes

  • Unidas Aluguel de Carros: mobilidade sob medida para pessoas e empresas.

  • Unidas Seminovos: veículos com procedência e ótimo custo-benefício.

POR QUE ESCOLHER A UNIDAS PARA SUA CARREIRA?

✨ Deu match com o nosso jeito de ser e busca um lugar onde possa crescer, aprender, inovar e fazer parte de uma história de transformação, a Unidas é o seu caminho certo .

title: Senior Applied Scientist
description:
Senior Applied Scientist (Remote – Brazil)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Location: Remote (Brazil) – São Paulo

Duration: Open-Ended

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Applied Scientist to lead the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning solutions. In this role, you will influence the technical direction of the team, collaborate closely with Product and Engineering partners, and drive innovation across data-driven initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines strong technical expertise with leadership capabilities and a passion for building high-impact solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end development and deployment of Machine Learning models to solve complex business problems.
  • Write and maintain clean, efficient, scalable code following industry best practices.
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and support data-informed decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies, including deep learning and modern frameworks, to build robust models.
  • Take ownership of key system components and influence the broader technical strategy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to design deployable, production-ready ML solutions.
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, fostering team expertise and growth.
  • Contribute to organizational technical leadership through patent filings and publications in top-tier venues.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning.
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML and deep learning models in production at scale.
  • Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, pipelines, feature engineering, experiment design).
  • Strong knowledge of algorithms and techniques such as gradient boosting, deep neural networks, transformers, and optimization methods.
  • Experience in Computer Vision ; experience in Causal Inference is highly desirable.
  • Expertise with Python scientific libraries (NumPy, pandas, Polars) and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-Learn).
  • Strong data engineering skills and comfort working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark).
  • Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Fluency in Python and SQL .

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related fields.
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail industry problems.
  • Familiarity with modern MLOps tools and pipelines .
  • Impact-driven mindset and commitment to delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience guiding or managing technical teams.

title: Finance Manager | Financial Operations (Brazil & Portugal)
description:
Na MyCareforce, já cobrimos +1.200.000 horas de enfermagem conectando +21.000 profissionais a +300 unidades de saúde em Portugal e Brasil. Somos uma empresa tecnológica em crescimento (+€3.3M investimento) com uma missão clara: melhorar a qualidade dos cuidados de saúde.

Sobre a Função

Buscamos um Finance Manager - Financial Operations com 4 a 6 anos de experiência , forte base em auditoria e controladoria , perfil hands-on e elevada capacidade analítica para liderar a operação financeira entre Brasil e Portugal.

Esta posição reporta diretamente ao CEO e ao Head of Strategy & Planning (S&P) e será responsável por garantir rigor financeiro, previsibilidade de caixa, qualidade de reporting e escalabilidade dos processos financeiros.

O papel exige alguém tecnicamente sólido, confortável com dados e automação, que prefira estruturar sistemas e processos a operar controles manuais, e que esteja em um estágio intermediário de carreira, com alto potencial de crescimento.

Responsabilidades

Governança Financeira, Auditoria & Compliance:

  • Garantir a integridade, rastreabilidade e consistência dos números financeiros.
  • Assegurar conformidade contábil e fiscal no Brasil e em Portugal, antecipando riscos e evitando passivos.
  • Atuar como ponto focal com contabilidades externas, auditorias e assessorias fiscais.

Tesouraria & Gestão de Caixa:

  • Gerir o fluxo de caixa consolidado Brasil–Portugal, com foco em previsibilidade e eficiência de capital.
  • Operar e acompanhar estruturas de crédito:

• Portugal: conta caucionada, factoring e instrumentos de curto prazo.

• Brasil: nota comercial e outras estruturas de financiamento.

  • Apoiar decisões de capital de giro junto ao CEO.

FP&A, Business Plan & Reporting Executivo:

  • Liderar o fechamento financeiro mensal, com análise crítica de desvios.
  • Atualizar, revisar e desafiar o Business Plan, projeções e cenários financeiros.
  • Produzir reports financeiros de nível executivo (DRE, Balanço, DFC) para diretoria, investidores e credores.

Tecnologia, Dados & Automação Financeira:

  • Manter e evoluir a infraestrutura financeira em Rows, utilizando SQL e APIs.
  • Automatizar rotinas financeiras e integrações com Omie, TOCOnline e InvoiceXpress.
  • Garantir consistência entre dados operacionais, contábeis e de reporting.

Liderança & Execução:

  • Coordenar e desenvolver um analista financeiro, garantindo qualidade e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Atuar como referência técnica interna em temas financeiros e fiscais.

Experiência & Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)

  • 4 a 6 anos de experiência profissional em finanças, auditoria, controladoria ou FP&A.

title: Senior Elixir Developer
description:
Who We Are Seeking:

We’re looking for a talented and experienced Elixir Backend Developer to join our international team and help design, build, and harden our agentic contracts execution layer —the platform where autonomous/agent-driven workflows orchestrate and execute contractual logic reliably, at scale. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. You’ll work on resilient OTP services, job orchestration, stateful workflows, and observability to ensure correctness, auditability, and performance. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work

Your Role and Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Elixir/OTP services (GenServer, Supervision trees, Registries) that power contract execution and agentic workflows.
  • Own the lifecycle of long-running, event-driven workflows (timers, scheduling, compensations/Saga patterns, exactly-once/at-least-once semantics).
  • Develop secure APIs and integrations, rate limiting, and request budgets for agent calls.
  • Optimize performance (ETS, streams, batching, backpressure) and observability (tracing, metrics, structured logs).
  • Collaborate with Product and AI/Agent teams to translate requirements into deterministic, testable contract execution flows.
  • Write high-quality tests, migrations, and production-grade documentation.

Tech You’ll Use:

  • Elixir /OTP (GenServer, Supervisors, Applications), Phoenix (APIs), Ecto (PostgreSQL), Oban, OpenTelemetry/PromEx
  • Message brokers & streams: Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Container & cloud: Docker , Kubernetes , AWS/GCP/Azure
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions (or similar), feature flags, migrations & rollout strategies

Essential Qualifications:

  • 3+ years building production Elixir/OTP services (or 5+ years BE + 1–2 years Elixir with strong OTP fundamentals).
  • Deep understanding of concurrency, supervision strategies, and fault tolerance on the BEAM.
  • Solid experience with Ecto/MySQL , schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Practical knowledge of job orchestration (Oban or equivalent), idempotency, retries, and backpressure.
  • Proven track record in building and maintaining event-driven or workflow systems with strong correctness guarantees.
  • Comfortable with containerized deployments and CI/CD; you ship and you own.
  • Strong written and spoken English (daily collaboration in English).

Who We Are:

DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, we aim to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.

What We Offer:

  • Contract-based hiring;
  • Full-time opportunity (40 hours per week);
  • 100% remote work / home office;
  • Performance-based bonuses tied to achievements and deliverables;
  • Open and flexible time-off policy;
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment;
  • Equipment program;
  • Paid days off per year + holidays (variable) + recess days;
  • Sponsorship program for relevant courses and training.

Live long and prosper!

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer

We’re looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.

You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.

This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Nosso objetivo é construir sistemas robustos e escaláveis que impulsionem o crescimento dos nossos clientes e da própria Hypesoft.

O que você fará

Como Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Júnior, você atuará em todo o ciclo de vida de produtos digitais, contribuindo tanto no back‑end (Node.js, Python e .NET) quanto no front‑end (React). Você terá mentoria contínua de engenheiros experientes, participará de decisões técnicas e ajudará a transformar requisitos de negócio em funcionalidades que impactam milhares de usuários.

  • Trabalhar em colaboração com designers, Product Owners e outros engenheiros para entender requisitos de produto e definir soluções viáveis.
  • Escrever código limpo, reutilizável e testável, seguindo boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Participar de revisões de código, pair programming e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Criar e manter testes automatizados básicos (unitários e de integração).
  • Ajudar a monitorar aplicações em produção, investigando e corrigindo incidentes de baixa complexidade.

Requisitos

  • Pelo menos 1  ano de experiência (profissional ou projetos acadêmicos/independentes) em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Conhecimento prático em Node.js ou Python e .NET para back‑end.
  • Experiência com React (Tailwind, Shadcn, Redux, etc) para construção de interfaces de usuário.
  • Noções de HTML, CSS e TypeScript.
  • Familiaridade com Git, APIs REST e boas práticas de versionamento de código.
  • Conceitos básicos de bancos de dados relacionais ou NoSQL.
  • Vontade de aprender novas tecnologias, receber feedback e evoluir rapidamente.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação.

Diferenciais

  • Uso de n8n ou outras plataformas de automação de fluxos.
  • Experimentos com Gen AI (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) em projetos pessoais ou profissionais.
  • Prática com serviços de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud).
  • Conhecimentos de testes de performance ou observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.).

Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia e quer crescer em um ambiente que valoriza autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e impacto real, a Hypesoft é o lugar certo para você. Candidate‑se e venha construir o futuro conosco!

Ensino médio completo;

Desejável superior ou técnico em elétrica, refrigeração, mecânica, hidráulica;

Curso de NR10.

Habilidades

Capacidade resolutiva;

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

  • Build and maintain working relationships to encourage team building and coaching / professional development of team.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About WSO2

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open-source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) products. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of APIs for secure delivery of digital services and applications, enabling thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries globally to drive their digital transformation journeys. Our open-source, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in, enabling rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has over 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with nearly USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more. Follow WSO2 on LinkedIn and X (formerly Twitter).

About the Role

As a Site Reliability Engineer at WSO2, you'll be instrumental in both supporting our existing customers with their managed or private cloud deployments and initiating new deployments across leading cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Your mission will include ensuring the seamless operation, scalability, and security of WSO2 cloud services, alongside automating processes to boost both efficiency and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Deployment Setup and Management:
  • Lead the design and implementation of new cloud deployments, tailoring solutions to meet stakeholder requirements on platforms like Azure, AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes.
  • Optimize cloud architectures for scalability and cost-effectiveness, adhering to best practices for networking, security, and access controls.
  • Gain and maintain deep knowledge of cloud infrastructure providers to create robust solutions.
  • Automation and CI/CD:
  • Craft and manage automation scripts and infrastructure as code (IaC) with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
  • Deploy CI/CD pipelines to streamline software delivery, testing, and deployment processes, ensuring efficient version control and configuration management.
  • Managed Cloud Support:
  • Ensure the availability of the services by configuring system monitors and alerts and attending to critical alerts in a timely manner.
  • Offer continuous support and maintenance for existing deployments, monitoring system performance and swiftly resolving issues to maintain high availability and reliability.
  • Implement strategies for performance optimization and failure prevention, conducting thorough root cause analyses to avoid future issues.
  • Monitoring and Security:
  • Establish comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems to oversee customer deployments, setting thresholds for incident response.
  • Conduct regular security assessments and stay abreast of the latest threats and trends to fortify cloud environments against risks.
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing:
  • Foster a collaborative environment with product developers, operations, and QA teams to enhance workflows and product quality.
  • Share knowledge and best practices, contributing to the team’s collective expertise through documentation, training, and mentorship.

Skills and Experience

  • Fluent in English.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Expertise in cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and GCP.
  • Expertise in Linux, virtualization and containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • A solid understanding of networking, security principles, and compliance frameworks.
  • Proficiency in IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation), configuration management (Puppet, Chef, Helm), and scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Github Actions, Jenkins) and monitoring/logging tools (Prometheus, ELK stack, Splunk).
  • Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills, coupled with a proactive, customer-centric mindset.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We've built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it's important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual's strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

title: Logistics & 3PL Operations Specialist
description:
About us

OPPO was founded in 2004 and is one of the global leaders in smart device innovation.

Our footprint covers more than 70 countries and regions , supported by over 300,000 sales outlets and 3,300 official service centers. We employ more than 40,000 dedicated professionals focused on creating a better life for customers worldwide through smarter products and services.

We are looking for experienced talent to join us on this exciting journey!

Responsibilities

1. Strategic Operations & 3PL Governance

  • Manage and govern the end-to-end national warehouse operations executed by 3PL partners, strategically ensuring peak efficiency in all logistics flows (inbound, outbound, and storage).
  • Oversee and optimize daily 3PL activities, implementing key metrics to maximize service levels, inventory accuracy, and processing timeliness.
  • Serve as the technical authority in high-value inventory control , establishing and maintaining rigorous protocols for IMEI/serial number tracking and reconciliation.

2. Regulatory Compliance & Auditing

  • Ensure full regulatory compliance by maintaining flawless consistency between physical goods, information systems, and complex Brazilian tax documentation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, etc.).
  • Conduct advanced, systematic auditing of 3PL adherence to SOPs and safety protocols, initiating corrective actions and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide expert advisory and practical support for NF-e invoicing , freight reconciliation, and assistance with complex ICMS tax reporting processes.

3. Project Management & Global Interface

  • Independently execute and drive key strategic logistics projects (e.g., major WMS/ERP system rollouts, warehouse network expansion) from planning through implementation.
  • Interface directly with the local Chinese team and Global Headquarters to align local operations with global supply chain strategy, acting as the primary subject matter expert in Brazil.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Accounting, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field.
  • Advanced English is mandatory (daily use).
  • Chinese is desirable.
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in Warehouse Management, 3PL Operations, or Logistics roles, with a proven track record of driving process ownership and high-impact results.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking , exceptional communication, and proven ability to operate with high autonomy and strong results-orientation.

Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level mastery of Brazilian logistics and tax legislation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, ICMS).
  • Advanced proficiency in WMS, TMS, and integrated ERP systems.
  • Demonstrated deep experience in managing and controlling high-volume, serialized inventory (IMEI/serial numbers).

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Machine Learning Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team.

Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil - Remote

Industry: IT & Services.

This position requires advanced communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

Machine Learning Engineer | About You

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you are responsible for turning complex data and business challenges into scalable, high‑impact AI solutions. You thrive in environments where experimentation meets engineering rigor, and you take pride in building systems that work reliably in the real world. You are the kind of person who enjoys staying ahead of industry trends—especially in LLMs and generative AI—and bringing that knowledge into practical, production-ready workflows. You’re excited by the opportunity to shape modern ML pipelines end‑to‑end, collaborate deeply with cross-functional teams, and continuously refine how AI drives value across an organization.

Machine Learning Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Develop and maintain scalable, reproducible machine learning pipelines across preprocessing, training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Build and optimize LLM-based solutions, including RAG approaches, embeddings, and semantic search capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to translate business needs into strong ML/AI system designs.
  • Prototype and deploy ML and deep learning models for transformation, ranking, prediction, and other applied use cases.
  • Design native workflows on AWS using Lambda, Step Functions, SageMaker, Bedrock, AgentCore, and related services.
  • Implement observability and monitoring tools to ensure reliability, stability, and compliance of models in production.

Machine Learning Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Machine Learning, with a proven track record deploying end‑to‑end ML/AI systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS AI/ML services including SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, and Step Functions, along with MLOps best practices.
  • Strong knowledge of LLMs, RAG architectures, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Proficiency in Python and ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch and scikit‑learn, familiarity with transformer-based models.
  • Solid understanding of model deployment, containerization, and monitoring.
  • Experience with data engineering for ML workflows (feature pipelines, schema versioning, data quality controls).
  • Advanced English proficiency for communication with a global, distributed team.

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.

How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ESCOPO DE ATIVIDADES

1. DESENVOLVIMENTO DE BACKEND E ARQUITETURA

Projetar, desenvolver e manter APIs e microsserviços robustos e escaláveis, utilizando a stack Node.js com NestJS (framework obrigatório), para a Topshare e para a plataforma Creatonomy. Isso inclui a modelagem, gestão e otimização de dados em bancos Neo4j (obrigatório) e MongoDB (desejável), garantindo a integridade e a alta disponibilidade do sistema. O profissional deverá contribuir ativamente para a definição da arquitetura de microsserviços e a evolução contínua da stack tecnológica. Será obrigatório o uso de Docker para empacotamento e execução dos serviços em ambientes isolados.

2. DEFINIÇÃO DE PADRÕES E ARQUITETURA

Estabelecer padrões de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de software e boas práticas para o backend. Será responsável por revisar e validar decisões arquiteturais, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e manutenibilidade dos sistemas. Deverá propor e implementar melhorias contínuas na infraestrutura e processos de CI/CD.

3. QUALIDADE DE CÓDIGO E TESTES

Utilizar Git e seguir rigorosamente as boas práticas de Git Flow, realizando pull requests e code reviews de forma contínua para assegurar a qualidade do código. Será responsável por implementar testes unitários com Jest, testes de integração e testes de carga para garantir a resiliência do sistema. Além disso, deverá atuar como referência técnica, compartilhando conhecimento e propondo melhorias na arquitetura e nos processos de CI/CD.

4. DISPONIBILIDADE PARA INCIDENTES CRÍTICOS

O Contratado se compromete a responder e atuar na correção de erros, bugs ou falhas críticas de produção em tempo hábil, fora do horário comercial, quando a indisponibilidade do sistema impactar diretamente a operação ou a receita da Contratante. Esta atuação é inerente à natureza do serviço de alta disponibilidade e não configura controle de jornada.

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS

• Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Backend, com foco em sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis

• Proficiência em Node.js

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com NestJS (framework Node.js para desenvolvimento de aplicações escaláveis)

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com testes unitários utilizando Jest

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com Neo4j (Banco de Dados Orientado a Grafos)

• Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e padrões de design

• Experiência sólida com Docker e conceitos de conteinerização

• Conhecimento e aplicação de boas práticas de versionamento com Git

• Experiência em design e otimização de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL

INFORMAÇÕES DA VAGA

Regime de Contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)

Remuneração: R$ 12.000,00/mês

Local: Remoto

Horário de Trabalho: De segunda a sexta-feira, em horário comercial

title: MSP Delivery Specialist (Bilingual English | Portuguese)
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. We partner with enterprise clients to streamline contingent workforce management, strengthen supplier relationships, and ensure program compliance. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.

Summary

Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests. This role serves as a key point of contact for client hiring managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless requisition management, compliance, and operational success. The ideal candidate has strong experience in recruitment, MSP operations, and Vendor Management Systems (VMS), combined with a customer service mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Job Description

  • Train, assist, and facilitate the requisition life cycle with client hiring managers and suppliers.
  • Support large-scale hiring initiatives, VMS data integrity projects, and supplier rationalization efforts.
  • Conduct intake calls, qualify candidate resumes, and manage requisition flow from posting through fulfillment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, suppliers, and internal program teams to ensure program success.
  • Maintain a service-focused approach, delivering a high-quality experience to all stakeholders.
  • Utilize and provide training on MSP tool such as Beeline and applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of required documentation by suppliers, maintaining adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and client-specific initiatives as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in a business-related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in MSP operations, or contingent workforce management .
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and experience with Beeline
  • Bilingual Competency across English and Portuguese
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly.
  • Proven success in a client-facing, fast-paced, and service-oriented environment.
  • Self-starter who can work independently and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities with a solution-driven mindset.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.

Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you’ll play a vital role in advancing workforce solutions that power some of the world’s leading organizations. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your MSP expertise, build strategic relationships, and make a meaningful impact in a company that values excellence and accountability.

Compensation and Benefits Disclosure

The specific compensation for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Our full-time consultants have access to benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401K contributions as well as any other PTO, sick leave, and other benefits mandated by appliable state or localities where you reside or work.

title: Bolsista Graduado - Grupo Boticário - UX - Produtos Digitais da Indústria | Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação ( PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa.

O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.

Projeto: UX - Produtos Digitais da Indústria

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Inovação e desenvolvimento são parte do DNA do Grupo Boticário, e você pode fazer parte de evolução. Estamos em busca de um talento colaborativo e analítico para atuar na criação de um sistema inédito de governança e acompanhamento dos programas de Desenvolvimento e Capacitação Industrial.

O projeto visa centralizar informações, automatizar processos e otimizar a alocação de mão de obra, trazendo mais eficiência, agilidade e inteligência à gestão fabril.

Se você quer contribuir com soluções que conectam tecnologia, pessoas e resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.

Formação Acadêmica: Design ou áreas correlatas

Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolver interfaces e fluxos de usuário intuitivos e eficazes, seguindo as melhores práticas de UX e os padrões de design do Grupo Boticário;
  • Colaborar com designers de produto e engenheiros na adoção, uso e documentação dos componentes;
  • Prototipar e conduzir testes de usabilidade para validar as soluções de design e aprimorar a experiência do usuário;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento, garantindo a implementação adequada e a consistência visual das interfaces;
  • Produzir e manter a documentação de design, incluindo guias de estilo e especificações técnicas;
  • Apresentar soluções de design e coletar feedback de stakeholders para promover melhorias contínuas

Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Formação em Design ou áreas correlatas, com experiência em UX para aplicações web ou mobile;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design como Figma ou similares;
  • Habilidades de comunicação;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de produto;
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes multifuncionais, multilíngues e colaborativos, com autonomia;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e trabalho em squads multidisciplinares;
  • Conhecimento sólido em princípios de design de interação, usabilidade e acessibilidade.
  • Conhecimento sobre Product Designer, aplicando conceitos de Arquitetura de Informação, Visual, UX Writing, Pesquisa qualitativa e quantitativa, além de métodos de facilitação;

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em pesquisa com usuários e testes de usabilidade;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento básico de React.

Soft Skills:

  • Proatividade e iniciativa para resolver problemas e buscar soluções inovadoras.
  • Visão sistêmica e multidisciplinar para integrar aspectos técnicos e de negócio.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e engajar diversos perfis profissionais.
  • Orientação a resultados, com foco em qualidade e prazos.

title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator who will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of all broadcast and content initiatives within Free Fire Esports. This role combines production, storytelling, and digital strategy expertise to deliver world-class esports broadcasts and high-impact content that enhance the fan experience. The Broadcast & Content Specialist/Coordinator acts as a bridge between internal teams, external vendors, influencers, and regional stakeholders to ensure creative alignment, operational excellence, and consistent brand storytelling across all tournaments and platforms.

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full broadcast and content pipeline for Free Fire Esports — from pre-production planning to live execution and post-event content delivery.
  • Manage relationships with broadcast vendors, studios, and creative agencies, ensuring adherence to Garena’s quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Supervise on-site production during tournaments, overseeing show flow, run-down execution, and coordination between technical, talent, and content teams.
  • Drive the creative direction of tournament broadcasts, including narrative development, talent integration, segment design, and audience interaction.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Social Media teams to align content distribution plans, ensuring maximum reach and engagement across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development of post-production deliverables (recaps, highlights, interviews, documentaries, etc.), ensuring consistency in tone, pacing, and storytelling.
  • Analyze viewership and engagement data to inform future broadcast and content strategies, identifying performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Support marketing teams with guidelines and toolkits to ensure global consistency of broadcast quality and messaging.
  • Manage the internal review process for scripts, visual assets, and show rundowns, ensuring narrative cohesion and compliance with brand standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging broadcast technologies, formats, and fan engagement tools to continuously evolve Free Fire Esports’ viewing experience.

Main job requirements:

  • Education: Completed higher education. Desirable in Communication, Broadcasting, Media Production, or related fields.
  • Experience: 6+ years in esports broadcast production, live event coordination, or content operations.
  • Proven track record leading complex, large-scale broadcast projects with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Strong understanding of esports ecosystems, gaming audiences, and live content dynamics.
  • Experience managing creative and technical production teams (e.g., camera crew, stage talent, editors, motion designers).
  • Solid analytical skills and ability to translate viewership metrics into actionable insights.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful execution of esports or entertainment broadcasts and digital content initiatives.

title: Senior Instrumentation Engineer - (Relocation to Saudi Arabia is required)
description:
Role : Senior Instrumentation Engineer

Job Description:

We are seeking an Instrumentation Engineer with extensive experience in Instrumentation utilized for the final control, monitoring and safety of Gas Plants, NGL Fractionation Plants, Refineries, petrochemicals plants, Pipelines and Distribution facilities, to join the Process Automation and Systems Division, which is part of the Process & Control Systems Department.

Process and Control Systems Department provides services in the field of process engineering, automation, new energy, and digitalization to various entities within Aramco.

As an Instrumentation Engineer your primary role will be to provide instrumentation engineering expertise to the various Aramco entities including designing, developing, installing, and troubleshooting. You will work with different disciplines such as operating sites, instrumentation engineering, facility planning, and project management. Additionally, you are expected to participate in the organization and company initiatives including safety programs, innovation programs, operational excellence, knowledge sharing, self-development and other programs as required.

Key Responsibilities:

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide support with all types of instrumentation including but not limited level, temperature, pressure, control valves, Emergency Isolation Valves, Motor Operated Valve, Relief Valves, flow measurement, level gauges etc.
  • Originate and carries out engineering studies to determine optimal solutions to complex technical problems, increase revenue, reduce cost, and improve process safety.
  • Works with and/or leads Task teams assigned to investigate incidents or solve specific technical problems.
  • Undertakes special assignments requiring extensive technical experience and discretion when dealing with outside organizations.
  • Develops and maintains Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards, Material Specifications, Procedures and Best Practices to enhance company profitability, safety, and productivity by applying and interpreting key industry codes and standards relevant to instrumentation and control.
  • Reviews and evaluates capabilities of vendors and contractors to determine their acceptability to perform major services to Saudi Aramco.
  • Acts as a Company representative in technical dealings with vendors, manufacturers, and design firms.
  • Perform technical evaluation for instrumentation quotations and attend technical bid evaluation meetings.
  • Evaluates and introduces best practices and new technologies to enable the Company to achieve Best in Class performance in oil and gas business.
  • Performs cost analyses and Value Engineering studies to recommend cost-effective solutions to technical issues.

Minimum Requirements:

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering preferably in Instrumentation, Mechanical or Electrical engineering. A Master's degree or PhD in Engineering is desired but not required.
  • Minimum 20 years of professional experience as an engineer in charge of technical work in field of specialty. Previous work with a major international Oil & Gas Company and/or previous employment with one of the Instrumentation suppliers used by Company is desired.
  • Must have experience in plant instrumentation sizing and selection (Control valves, Pressure Relief valves, Actuators, Basic Process Measurement etc.)
  • Certified in ISA- Certified Automation Professional (CAP), Certified Functional Safety Professional (CFSP), TUV FSEng, Principles & Practice of Engineering (PE) certification, or Chartered Engineer (C.E.) license or registration.
  • Basic knowledge of H2S, LEL, pH, conductivity, O2 analyzer, CO/CO2 analyzer, fire & gas detectors and Gas chromatographs is preferred.
  • Proficiency in the International codes and standards used within the oil and gas industry, i.e., API, BS, ISO, ASME, ANSI, IEC, ISA, IEEE, etc.
  • Have participated as lead engineer in HAZOP, SIL, P&ID, Design, and model reviews.
  • Understanding of control systems, compressor and pumps field instrumentation, speed controllers, Vibration Monitoring Systems (VMS), Compressor Control Systems (CCS).
  • Understanding communication protocols like DNP3, Modbus, FieldBus, TCP, IEC, SPA, RP570, ANSI and General Process Automation Protocols.
  • Have been an active member in a relevant professional society, (i.e., ISA, IEEE, etc.) for a minimum of 3 years and have been holding current membership.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Us

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

We’re building the infrastructure that powers smarter agency discovery, matchmaking, and evaluation—and we’re looking for a developer who wants real ownership over how that system is built and evolves.

⸻

The Role

As Vendry’s Developer, you’ll be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the core technical infrastructure that powers the Vendry platform. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership across frontend, backend, and internal tooling.

You’ll manage everything from our public-facing website and landing pages to our agency portal and proprietary agency search engine. You’ll work closely with the founding team to ship features quickly, improve performance and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of the product.

This is an ideal role for a developer who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys autonomy, and is excited to build and iterate fast.

⸻

Responsibilities

• Own and manage Vendry’s full technical stack, including:

• Frontend website and marketing landing pages

• Agency portal and internal tools

• Proprietary agency search and matchmaking engine

• Build, ship, and maintain new features across the product with a focus on speed, quality, and scalability.

• Ensure the platform is reliable, performant, and secure as usage grows.

• Collaborate closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Stay up to date on modern development trends, tools, and best practices.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve velocity and code quality.

• Troubleshoot issues across the stack and proactively improve system architecture.

• Document technical decisions and maintain clean, readable codebases.

⸻

Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience as a software developer or engineer.

• Experience working in a startup environment is a must.

• Strong experience with modern frontend and backend development.

• Comfortable owning projects end-to-end, from idea to production.

• Familiarity with databases, APIs, and search or filtering systems is a plus.

• Experience building or maintaining SaaS products or internal platforms is strongly preferred.

• Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and clear written communication.

⸻

Compensation

• Salary: $2,000–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and scope.

• Full-time, remote role.

⸻

Why Join Vendry

Joining Vendry means having real ownership over a product that’s redefining how brands find agency partners. You won’t be maintaining a tiny slice of a massive codebase—you’ll be shaping the foundation of a growing platform.

  • We’re a small, fast-moving team that values initiative, clarity of thinking, and building practical solutions that actually get used. If you enjoy shipping, iterating, and seeing your work directly impact the business, you’ll feel right at home.

title: Analista financeiro internacional
description:
Gerir de forma eficiente os recursos financeiros da empresa, com foco em tesouraria e operações internacionais, visando otimizar a liquidez, reduzir riscos financeiros e garantir a conformidade regulatória. Atuar na gestão do fluxo de caixa, operações cambiais, investimentos, financiamentos e na elaboração de relatórios financeiros, assegurando uma base sólida para a expansão global e o crescimento sustentável do negócio.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir a liquidação financeira de todas as operações no ambiente bancário, efetuando a gestão do fluxo de caixa da empresa (recebimentos e pagamentos), além de otimizar a aplicação de excedentes de caixa. Efetuar as Conciliações de contas bancárias mensais, anuais, apoiando a equipe de Contabilidade, assegurando a integridade dos registros financeiros.
  • Enviar Reconciliações das contas cliente x fornecedor - SoA Análise.
  • Ser responsável pelo fechamento de operações de câmbio e Hedge, realizando cotações, definindo a melhor estratégia, acompanhando a formalização e liquidação, até o processo de controle e o arquivamento das operações.
  • Elaborar e analisar relatórios e apresentações financeiras, incluindo previsões de fluxo de caixa para fornecer insights precisos à alta administração.
  • Efetuar o controle de produtos e empréstimos internacionais.
  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de faturamento, acompanhando todas as etapas desde a geração das invoices até a cobrança, garantindo que os clientes sejam faturados de forma correta e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos. Assegurar a acuracidade das faturas por meio da revisão e validação prévia das informações, prevenindo erros que possam gerar impactos financeiros ou insatisfação dos clientes.
  • Administrar a periocidade do faturamento, assegurando a pontualidade nos processos, bem como a emissão de notas fiscais e notas de crédito, em conformidade com as políticas internas e as regulamentações fiscais e legais aplicáveis.
  • Atuar na automatização de processos e na implementação de melhorias contínuas, visando ganhos de eficiência e redução de riscos operacionais.
  • Realizar o acompanhamento dos recebíveis, em parceria com a equipe de cobrança, assegurando o recebimento dos pagamentos dentro dos prazos acordados e mitigando riscos de inadimplência.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais sobre faturamento, receitas e inadimplência, além de análises de desempenho que apoiem a tomada de decisões estratégicas pela liderança.
  • Atender auditorias e demandas de conformidade, garantindo que os processos de faturamento estejam aderentes às políticas internas e às normas fiscais e contábeis.
  • Interagir com áreas internas, incluindo Vendas (WSI), Financeiro e Atendimento ao Cliente, colaborando na resolução de questões relacionadas ao faturamento e assegurando o cumprimento dos contratos firmados com os clientes.
  • Realizar cadastros e a manutenção de clientes nos sistemas operacionais (GCS, SIPNAV, PORTA e ALARIS), bem como a atualização e manutenção das informações financeiras no CRM.
  • Coordenar a implementação de sistemas e ferramentas de gestão financeira, promovendo a automação e a eficiência dos processos de tesouraria.

Requisitos

  • Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Gestão Financeira
  • Inglês avançado para escrita e conversação
  • Vivência com rotinas de tesouraria, operações internacionais e análises financeiras de forma autônoma
  • Conhecimento no pacote Office, especialmente excel
  • Alto nível de comprometimento com as tarefas e projetos
  • Autogestão e orientação para resultados

Atuação Híbrida 2x por semana presencial na Faria Lima.

Horário de Segunda a Sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h48.

Regime CLT.

Benefícios

  • VT

title: Technical Recruiter
description:

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay).   • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment

  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.

In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.

Nice to have:

  • Golang experience

This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: IT Data Engineer Sênior

title: Senior Cloud SRE
description:
Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer

As a Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer , you will join a specialized engineering task force dedicated to preventing and resolving the most critical and strategic customer issues encountered in the field.

Our global team of experienced engineers has a deep understanding of the lower layers of private cloud infrastructure. Together, we work on practical solutions, continuously learning and adapting. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and tackle challenges head-on.

If you're an engineer eager to understand the core of cloud technologies and looking for a team that values hands-on expertise , you'll fit right in with us.

What you will learn and contribute to

  • Maintain and enhance Red Hat private cloud: You’ll work extensively with Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS) , private cloud solutions based on Kubernetes and OpenStack .
  • Deep Dive Troubleshooting: Starting from high-level Kubernetes error messages, you’ll navigate through multiple layers until pinpointing issues—even down to kernel-level bugs.
  • Automate and Develop: Spend 30–50% of your time developing automation to prevent recurring issues. Solve it once, automate for the future. Use your Python skills to create health checks and improve reliability.
  • Continuous Learning: In our rapidly evolving tech landscape, ongoing learning is a cornerstone.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Engineers: Work closely with developers and product engineers to bridge infrastructure and software, ensuring seamless product delivery.
  • Mode of Operation: This role requires participation in a follow-the-sun scheme with 12-hour shifts (within regulatory limits) or participation in on-call rotations to ensure business continuity during emergencies.

Your skills and experience

  • Linux Expertise: Strong familiarity with Linux distributions; we primarily use Red Hat and CentOS .
  • Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VLANs, IP routing). Experience with Calico , Multus , and Open vSwitch is a plus.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills and analytical thinking to address complex challenges.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Bash and Python , or willingness to learn, plus familiarity with Ansible .
  • Containerization & Virtualization: Knowledge of Podman , Kubernetes , Helm , and/or OpenStack ; experience with KVM/QEMU is advantageous.
  • Storage Systems: Experience with Ceph and Rook is highly valued.
  • Database Expertise: Understanding of relational databases ( MySQL , MariaDB ) and experience with etcd .
  • Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with tools like ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) , Prometheus , and Grafana .
  • Advanced written and spoken English.

It would be nice if you also had

  • Proactive thinking and ownership mindset.
  • Strong focus on quality and reliability.
  • Passion for delivering training or knowledge-sharing sessions to operations teams.

Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

title: Analista de Inteligência de Negócios Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas - Shopping Parque D. Pedro
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Atuar na prospecção comercial de novos negócios para o shopping com histórico comprovado de atingimento ou superação de metas de vendas, preferencialmente em segmentos de alta competitividade ou de shopping centers..
  • Gerir a negociação (locação) dos espaços comerciais do shopping (mall, eventos, feiras) vendas B2B ou vendas consultivas, com ticket médio elevado;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais (valores, condições, prazo etc.). Capacidade de planejar e executar estratégias de vendas de médio e longo prazo;
  • Identificar marcas com perfil aderente ao shopping segundo o posicionamento estabelecido, experiência sólida em negociações complexas, atuação com foco na relação ganha ganha.
  • Participar de comitês comerciais para aprovação das propostas apresentadas;
  • Acompanhar o pós-venda, estudo e mapeamento das tendências de mercado;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores de resultados da área e do segmento.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Superior completo: em Administração, Marketing, Comunicação social, Economia, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento do mercado de shoppings;
  • Domínio em Técnicas de Negociação;
  • Vivência com comercialização;
  • Pacote Office avançado.

title: Supervisor (a) Florestal - Proteção Florestal
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.
